name: 源函数保持的解剖漂移近端推断
purpose: Preserve full original source function and constrain adaptation-induced cross-organ occupancy drift relative to the frozen source on each current image; no absolute shape correction at source.
source_reference: q0(x)=softmax(f0(x)); frozen native FixMatch43600 EMA; current input only
student: qtheta via existing zero-entry 16->8->16 adapter B tanh(Ah); native backbone and real 3x3 head frozen

source_stage.reuse: V2 source prior and final EMA calibration, immutable read-only
source_stage.new_source_gate: Q/R source output equals q0 mathematically; numerical probability max error<=5e-7 and argmax exact, old-source paired mean/CI/p10 all zero; N saved rows reused
source_stage.failure: Any source function or source gate failure stops before target qualification

structural_model.pi: V2 frozen mode head applied to detached original h0 only, fixed throughout each solve and adaptation
structural_model.W: V2 frozen scale head on detached h0 only, W=s2/(s2+b2), [0,1]
structural_model.mu_bar: sum_k pi_k mu_k; only used to build between-mode uncertainty directions
structural_model.F_x: concatenate sqrt(pi_k)*F_k for all 8 modes and sqrt(pi_k)*(mu_k-mu_bar) for all 8 modes; rank<=72; do not average eigenvector columns
structural_model.d_x: sum_k pi_k sigma2_k, lower bounded by existing 1e-6 numerical floor
structural_model.curvature_match: both second derivatives at zero equal 1/d_x_j; R influence magnitude never exceeds Q at equal standardized residual
structural_model.constraints: P in 4-class simplex; u>=0,sum_c u_c<=1; z unconstrained
structural_model.source_identity_proof: qtheta=q0, P=q0,u=a0,z=0 gives all nonnegative terms zero; KL forces unique P=q0 at any global minimizer. No mixture latent-rho optimization or absolute-mu attraction.
structural_model.convexity: fixed x/pi/W/F/d: Q and pseudo-Huber are convex; KL strict in P, z quadratic coercive. Conditional latent and occupancy minimizers unique; no global Student-t nonconvexity.
structural_model.scope: Source-function preservation is exact for readout on any source-entry input; it does not prove old-domain retention after theta changes or correct source errors on the new domain.

solver.latent: SPD72 or smaller solve; pseudoHuber IRLS uses 1/(d*sqrt(1+r^2/d)), matched to Q at r=0
checks: analytic derivative against independent finite difference on synthetic data
nonnegative robust penalty and R influence <=Q
solver.failure: Stop on failed qualification, runtime or stationarity; do not increase iterations or tolerances in-run
solver.gradient: differentiate complete finite unroll; no early identity-return branch that silently removes structural derivatives

adaptation.data: same Philips 13 train-L patients; no old images/labels/U/test
adaptation.objective: same ordinary GT pixel CE + present foreground Dice on final P for all arms; no trainable calibration head or mode head
adaptation.teacher_calls: same current-image frozen source forward for all arms including N

controls.method: native observation plus same adapter and GT task loss
full source-anchored curvature-matched pseudo-Huber drift inference; primary

qualification.shared_distinguishability: N qualification terminal batch graph evaluates Q/R structural gradient contrast; distance>=.05 and finite nonzero active gradient away from entry; no new probe extension or seed
qualification.near_entry_gradient: Structural value/gradient can vanish at qtheta=q0 by design; do not incorrectly reject the intended identity as missing gradient

provisional_caps.binding_status: FROZEN: native source2176, qualification600, formal24000, evaluation7224; reverse qualification150/formal6018; optimizer6096. No extra probe.

final_science_gates.source: No loss of source readout, stricter function identity above

logging_required: aggregate real W and anatomical active region weighting
posterior correction norms and classwise argmax flip counts
matched Q/R influence ratio and standardized residual strata
per-block energy and full stationarity residual
patient-level original/own-source paired CI and tails; public aggregates only
do_not: add new anatomy data or calibration split silently
claim no forgetting without old-domain evidence
start a new monitor or experiment before explicit user acceptance
authority: User explicitly approved V3 complete single-seed validation; source function and competence gates before adaptation.
